page.layout: One page of running text in one column. At the top, a dedication block set in larger and centred type. Below it, the body of the letter in one column. No margin notes. Printed signature at the foot.

main_text.l: KAROLO VTENHOVIO
NIEVLANDIÆ &c. Dn. VIRO
nobilissimo, doctissimo,
IANVS GRVTERVS
Imocati isthac quae vides, inscripserat
nomini tuo Kimedoncius noster, Colonia
Agrippina redux: partim testandae gratitu-
dini; quod dum isthic apud vos ageret, nullo non be-
nevolentiae ac prothymiae genere cum prosecutus fu-
eras: partim quoniam & Graecas literas, & aetatem
cius, quae pueros vix exibat, optime nouisses: ideoque
& errantem corrigere humaniter, & erratis co-
mmitter veniam dare possis. At enim ut Menandri-
no verfui fidem adstraxit:
Ὃν οἱ θεοὶ φιλᾶσιν ἀποθνῄσκει νέος,[?]
fatusque ac Deo visum, eripere ipsum rebus humanis,
quū solummodo vixisset annos septemdecim, men-
ses IX. dies VIII. quod ipsemet praepropero abitu
impeditus praestare nequiit, idego nunc praesto: opus,
spero & tibi pariter & defuncto gratum acceptu-
mque. ideoq; simile quid mox facturus circa utriusq;,
Philostrati Imagines, Heroica, Epistolas, &c. nec
non Descriptiones Callistrati, Alciphronisque E-
pistolas, quae omnia vertit Latine. si minus accura-
te, quid mirum? imo quid tum? fatis est aestimatio-
ni hominum subiecisse, quantos qualesque fructus
haec arbuscula latura fuisset, paulo maturior, quae
iam tunc praecocis ingenii luxuriabat flosculis & colore
simul & odore commendabilibus quo parū aetatis

page.notes: The Greek line is a Menander quotation; its exact letters (φιλᾶσιν, ἀποθνῄσκει) are read from a small scan and should be checked against the printed text. "Imocati" and "cius" are copied as printed. The line ending "quo parū aetatis" continues onto the next page, which is not on this scan. The page number is not printed; only the signature "A a" appears at the foot.
